Method of Attack: DDoS attacks on Ukrainian government websites
Malware planted on vulnerable government servers to add devices into attacker-controlled botnet
Infected government web servers used for further DDoS attacks
Discoverer: National Coordination Center for Cybersecurity (NCCC) at the National Security and Defense Council (NSDC) of Ukraine
Impacted Systems: Websites of the Security Service of Ukraine
National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine
Resources of other state institutions and strategic enterprises
Attack Vector: Vulnerable government web servers infected with malware
IP addresses located on Russian networks used as source of attacks
